_doc: Claims the system makes ABOUT ITSELF, each with a mechanical check. Seeded 2026-10-21 (GAUNTLET, Council 4-1) after three such claims were found false in one night. 'expected' records the verdict known at seeding, so a CHANGE is visible, not just a failure. Run: python3 scripts/check_claims.py Kind 'ledger_pass' (added 2026-10-21 with the run-ledger, scripts/run_ledger.py) asks whether a gate actually RAN and passed, from rows only a running gate writes. Wired into scripts/gates.py as its last gate (D-CLAIM-1 option b): the gate passes when every verdict equals 'expected'.

claims.claim: roster-provenance.csv is kept current by the weekly in-season pull
claims.note: No writer exists in either repo. Fixing this is D-INT-1, still an owner decision.

claims.claim: the provenance freshness gate runs during the morning run
claims.note: season_board.py imports rank_engine's functions, never its main(), so the gate is dormant in-season.

claims.claim: the deck's live ESPN roster verification is the in-season control for team labels
claims.note: The kit imports only verify_rosters.norm (the name fold), not the verification. This is why D-INT-1 option (c) was withdrawn on 2026-10-21.

claims.claim: the Season Deck is rebuilt by the morning run
claims.asserted_in: scripts/morning.py step list; the morning scheduled task
claims.note: Known-answer control: the detector must be able to return SUPPORTED (adversarial-verify rule 9).

Known-answer control for writer_exists. gates.py writes it via open(a.out, 'w') where --out's default carries the path; the detector failed this case on first run (2026-10-21) and was generalized to follow argparse defaults. Regression guard.

claims.claim: the red team's attack records describe the live engine
claims.asserted_in: any report that quotes a structural band (red-team skill rule 4: fingerprint or STALE)
claims.note: The red-team fingerprint check as a query on the ledger (Council 2026-10-21). SUPPORTED since 2026-10-21 06:20Z: the five fingerprinted records (A-1, A-5, A-7, A-8, A-9) re-run on deck 80eecdf (owner "proceed with all", D-RT-STALE) and run_attacks --check passed. It goes FALSIFIED again at the next deck commit (run_attacks keys on the deck HEAD), and the gate then fails until the attacks are re-run. History: FALSIFIED at seeding: the four attack records were made on 259c630 and the engine changed on 2026-10-21 (D-PM-4 recovery). Flips to SUPPORTED only when run_attacks --check passes on the live engine, i.e. after the sweep is re-run (D-RT-STALE) — the gate then fails until this row's 'expected' is updated, which is the point.

claims.claim: the kit report gate has run and passed through scripts/gates.py
claims.asserted_in: every PR body that quotes gates.json
claims.note: Known-answer control for ledger_pass (adversarial-verify rule 9): the detector must be able to return SUPPORTED. gates.py writes this row before check_claims runs in the same invocation.
